name: Runemaster audit: Phaser cuts Phase Out's cooldown by 30s and removes its mana cost (#3067)
contract: Phaser 706518 effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER, EffectMiscValue 11 (SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN), EffectBasePoints -30001 + DieSides 1 = -30000; effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, EffectMiscValue 14 (SPELLMOD_COST), EffectBasePoints -101 + 1 = -100%. Both effects' EffectSpellClassMask word 0 is 64. Phase Out 500671 has SpellFamilyName 38, SpellFamilyFlags word 0 bit 6 (64) - an exact classmask match. Player::ApplySpellMod must therefore subtract 30000ms from any op-11 query and zero out any op-14 query against 500671 once 706518 is learned.

steps.label: 706518 op 11 flat -30000 reaches 500671 (classmask matches Phase Out's family flags)
